text:
alex.w: FYI we just saw a ~0.6% uptick in failed tool-call invocations for free-tier APAC traffic after the routing change this morning. logs show tool payloads missing args sometimes.

maria.t: ugh. which fallback path was hit? variant or region fallback?

alex.w: router routed to mmini-7B (cheaper) when primary m3-large saturated. issue appears only when fallback variant is used. staging replay reproduces it.

samir: same repro in staging yesterday after the canary. quick diff suggests tokenizer differences + context truncation ordering. small variants use bpe-legacy, prod uses sentencepiece.

emily.k: important: tool-calling parity is brittle. if tokenizer changes tokenization around separators we reorder tool args -> tool parser fails. we should add a compatibility gate in router.

alex.w: minimal repro log snippet: 
```
request: "Call get_weather(city=\"San Jose\")"
m3-large tokenized -> [CALL, GET_WEATHER, 'city', '=', 'San', 'Jose'] -> tool payload ok
mmini-7B tokenized -> [CALL, GET_WEATHER, 'city', '=', 'San', 'J', 'ose'] -> parsing breaks
```

maria.t: can we put a small compatibility matrix in the router config? i.e. require tokenizer parity + context >= request len + toolcall-schema-check.

emily.k: proposed check order: 1) exact tokenizer family (sentencepiece vs bpe), 2) effective max_context >= request_length + safety_margin, 3) toolcall-schema-quick-parse. Fail safe -> skip variant.

samir: +1. also add telemetry buckets so we can count affected customers by tier/region. e.g. queries: 
```
select count(distinct customer_id) from requests
where routed_to_variant = 'mmini-7B'
and toolcall_failed = true
and region = 'ap-southeast-1'
and ts between X and Y;
```

ops: ops note: current quota/route policy allowed fallback for free-tier to any cheaper variant. that policy might be too permissive for toolcall-heavy endpoints.

alex.w: suggestion: add per-route compatibility_profile that lists supported tokenizer families and toolcall_parity boolean. Router should consult compatibility_profile before routing. Default is permissive for text-only endpoints.

emily.k: UX for Console: show small badge on route config "compatibility: strict/lenient" and a quick button to run a simulated routing check for a sample prompt. UX should show why a fallback was rejected (tokenizer mismatch / context / schema).

maria.t: for rollout plan: add a canary that denies fallback for routes with toolcall_parity=true, run for 48h in ap-southeast-1, surface telemetry in a new dashboard tile that shows "fallback-induced tool failures" by customer tier.

alex.w: action items:
- samir to add router check + compatibility_profile (PR by EOD Thu)
- emily to prototype console badge + simulated check (mockups by Mon)
- ops to add telemetry query + dashboard tile (query + draft tile by Fri)
- maria to update routing policy docs and gating rules (doc PR)

dev-bot: deploy canary to ap-southeast-1 scheduled at 2026-03-21T17:30:00Z :rocket:

emily.k: thanks — ping me when canary is up, will run sample prompts through simulated-check.

samir: noted, will include a small unit test that compares tokenization outputs between variants for canonical separators.

maria.t: one more ask — include customer tier in telemetry so we can measure free vs paid impact separately.

alex.w: agreed. I'll sync with data infra after this thread and attach the sample query. thanks all :thumbsup:
